scale: 0.10 to 1.00; higher means the player is expected to visit the module more often
method: Gameplay-informed heuristic weights. They are not hidden game constants. They are used only in the secondary travel-distance objective after all hard constraints and the minimum Elevator count are satisfied.

airlock.rationale: Primary entry/exit and fast-travel return point; used throughout ordinary exploration.

captains_cabin.rationale: Daily sleep/end-day anchor and frequent start/end point.

workshop.rationale: Frequent crafting of consumables, repair items and quest items; directly visited especially early and during emergencies.

command_center.rationale: Base building, rearrangement, expansion and journey actions; recurring operational hub.

machinery.rationale: Maintenance, repair orders and radiation-filter management make it a recurring technical stop.

kitchen.rationale: Food production and canteen use recur, but many production tasks can be delegated.

research_lab.rationale: Research is frequent strategically, although Scientist work can be assigned remotely.

communication_room.rationale: Required and optional Earth/Ally Corp communications recur but not continuously.

infirmary.rationale: Important when treating injuries/radiation, otherwise intermittent.

refinery.rationale: Useful production room, commonly operated by an Alter rather than personally by Jan.

greenhouse.rationale: Useful production room, usually delegated and therefore lower direct foot traffic.

quantum_computer.rationale: Critical but episodic use for Alters/qubit progression rather than daily traversal.

gym.rationale: Optional wellbeing use; not a core daily player route.

gamers_den.rationale: Optional recreation module with intermittent use.

park_with_bench.rationale: Optional/social use rather than operational traffic.

materializer.rationale: Important late-game function but episodic rather than a daily operational stop.

womb.rationale: Essential story module but physically visited only around Alter creation/events.

dormitory.rationale: Required for Alters but Jan generally does not need to visit it for routine operation.

small_storage.rationale: Storage capacity is passive; direct player entry is normally unnecessary.

medium_storage.rationale: Storage capacity is passive; direct player entry is normally unnecessary.

large_storage.rationale: Storage capacity is passive; direct player entry is normally unnecessary.

ark_sarcophagus.rationale: Special storage/terminal module with rare direct use.

rapidium_ark.rationale: Special terminal storage; must be connected but should not drive central placement.

recycler.rationale: Passive organics generation; little or no routine direct interaction.

radiation_repulsor.rationale: Passive utility; direct traversal is not required and it is non-transit.
